about: Countersign is electronic signing for a team. Upload a PDF, add who signs and in what order, drop signature, initials, date and text fields on the page, and send. Each person signs from a link on their phone or computer, with no account. When everyone has signed, Countersign seals a final PDF with a certificate of completion, and anyone can check that file on the verify page. Templates, bulk sending from a spreadsheet, public signing links, a REST API, webhooks and MCP tools are built in.
